rationale: Q3/Q4 earnings and FCF are exceptionally strong and new take-or-pay SCAs plausibly reduce historical cycle volatility. Current price can support attractive returns if normalized EPS stays near the Q4 guided run-rate, but margin/cycle mean-reversion risk prevents automatic full-size entry.

Current public FY2027 expectation evidence around $155-$158 EPS and the 2026-08-21 price imply a low forward multiple, but the 24-month base case only clears roughly a 15% annualized hurdle if normalized EPS remains near $160 at an 8x exit multiple. This supports an experimental starter, not full sizing.

Founder/reviewer approved the documented Decision-Grade framework. The >7% intraday decline improves mechanical valuation asymmetry but triggers a cause review because competitive supply is load-bearing; promotion governs research quality and does not authorize a same-day trade.
execution_overlay: No order until the intraday move is re-underwritten against company/industry evidence and aggregate AI-memory-semiconductor risk is acceptable.
